title: SGLT2 inhibitors for HFmrEF/HFpEF: DELIVER and EMPEROR-Preserved

reference.citation: Vaduganathan M, Docherty KF, Claggett BL, et al. SGLT2 inhibitors in patients with heart failure: a comprehensive meta-analysis of five randomised controlled trials. Lancet. 2022;400(10354):757-767.

topic: SGLT2 inhibitors compared with placebo for cardiovascular death or first hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction

expected_primary_result.notes: Prespecified meta-analysis of DELIVER and EMPEROR-Preserved in LVEF >40%; primary endpoint was time to cardiovascular death or first hospitalization for heart failure.

aliases: Dapagliflozin in Heart Failure with Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction
Dapagliflozin Evaluation to Improve the Lives of Patients With Preserved Ejection Fraction Heart Failure
expected_trials.expected_primary_timepoint: time to cardiovascular death or worsening heart failure
expected_trials.notes: NEJM DELIVER primary outcome was worsening heart failure or cardiovascular death; the prespecified Lancet meta-analysis harmonized this to cardiovascular death or first hospitalization for heart failure.

aliases: Empagliflozin in Heart Failure with a Preserved Ejection Fraction
Empagliflozin Outcome Trial in Patients With Chronic Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction
expected_trials.expected_primary_timepoint: time to cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure
expected_trials.notes: NEJM EMPEROR-Preserved primary composite outcome was cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure.

adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.label: DAPA-HF
adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.reason: Included in the five-trial all-HF Lancet meta-analysis but not in the two-trial HFmrEF/HFpEF prespecified benchmark subset.

adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.label: EMPEROR-Reduced
adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.reason: Included in the five-trial all-HF Lancet meta-analysis but not in the HFmrEF/HFpEF subset.

adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.label: SOLOIST-WHF
adjacent_nonbenchmark_records.reason: Included in the five-trial all-HF Lancet meta-analysis for worsening HF irrespective of EF, but not part of the DELIVER/EMPEROR-Preserved HFmrEF/HFpEF subset.
